title: Asynchronous activity heartbeat
description: A non-terminal progress record for an activity handed off with WillCompleteAsync, submitted as the OCAML_TEMPORAL_CORE_CLIENT_CALL_ASYNC_ACTIVITY_HEARTBEAT client call (#1025). It carries the attempt's heartbeat timeout, from which the bridge derives the per-token throttle interval; null (or a zero duration) selects the worker's default interval.
